SF014 playback transforms the source with one loaded Lockhart cell. Common
input calibration is .2modelV peak; Drive1/3/6, normal4x+ADAA, outputVolts/8.
Dry is the same calibrated source/8. Raw/common/RMS-matched are separately
labeled, with every gain/RMS/peak in renders.csv. Musical renders add .2s tail.
Optional same-take RAT/Muff/CMOS comparison adds2s tail and reports differing
model/output scales; it is a musical comparison, not equal electrical drive.
